Struct RectangleI

Namespace: osu.Framework.Graphics.Primitives
Assembly: osu.Framework.dll

Stores a set of four integer numbers that represent the location and size of a rectangle. The code was duplicated from System.Drawing.Rectangle.

[Serializable]
